decisions.diagnosis: Counter 328 counted every bike twice in both directions from installation until 19 May 2024, so the counts should be halved.
decisions.evidence: Over 209 days every non-zero slot is even: 1557 had 2000 twos, 287 fours and 0 odd slots; 1558 had 2444 twos, 340 fours and 0 odd slots. On 20 May 2024 odd counts appear in both directions at once, and daily totals halve overnight: 1557 went from 14-16 to 6-9 and 1558 from 30-40 to 10-18. Mostly 1s follow.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 328 lost nearly all detections in both directions for a month and then recovered abruptly mid-afternoon, which points to a sensor fault; the bikes it missed cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: Daily totals fell from 25-60 to 0-10, with 9 whole days of warning-flagged zeros (1558: 17, 19, 27, 29 and 30 Jun and 1-3 Jul; 1557: 2-3 Jul). Weekly totals were 39/19, 33/9 and 29/13 against 250-330 before. Buckland St (254) nearby was normal (2640-3141 a week). West fell much further than East. Counts resumed at 16:15 on Friday 4 Jul, and the next days ran at 18-49 a day.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 350 reported a whole weekday of warning-flagged zeros in both directions while bikes were passing; nothing was recorded, so it cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: 23 Oct 2025 (a normal weekday): 96 warning records of 0 in each direction. The days either side had 63/59 and 68/76 bikes, and counts stop after 22:30 on the 22nd and resume at 05:45 on the 24th.

decisions.diagnosis: The East direction nearly stopped counting for five days, with two warning-flagged zero days, while West kept counting; this may be a partial sensor fault, but at this site's low volume it cannot be settled.
decisions.evidence: East daily totals were 2, 1, 2, 0 and 0 (warnings on 15 and 16 Dec) against 9-16 in the days before and 10-18 after. West recorded 9, 4, 6, 3 and 7. East evening peaks of 8-10 bikes on 10-11 Dec vanish until 17 Dec.

series.name: Geddes Ave eastbound
series.evidence: Counter 350 replaced 328 at the same site with no overlap (328 ends 15 Sep 2025, 350 starts 16 Sep), both labelled East. The level carries on: 328 had 41/day in Sep 2025 and 53 on 15 Sep; 350 had 42-68/day in the following week, in line with the site's steady growth.

series.name: Geddes Ave westbound (citybound)
series.evidence: This is a like-for-like replacement in the West direction: 328 had 44/day in Sep 2025 and 51 on 15 Sep; 350 had 38-66/day in the following two weeks. The East/West balance is the same before and after.

useful: doubled: flagged the 209-day all-even run in both directions straight away
daily with odd_slots/nonzero_slots: showed the exact day doubling ended (19 to 20 May 2024)
weekly across the site and a neighbour (254): showed the June 2025 collapse was local
raw Status: warning flags confirmed the whole-day outages
hourly: compared the daily shape before, during and after the June 2025 drop
not_useful: zeros at the default 6 hours: at a low-volume site almost every night qualifies, so the list is swamped; min_hours=24 was needed
events: nothing listed for this area
improve: zeros: scale the threshold to the direction's volume, or rank runs by the bikes they should have had
doubled: report the date of the first odd slot after a run so the boundary can be seen without checking by hand
add: a tool that lists warning-flagged days next to the other direction's count and the counts of nearby sites that day

summary: Site 540 is a low-volume Zetland bike path with strong growth. Counter 328 double-counted in both directions until 19 May 2024, so those counts are halved. It then nearly stopped detecting from 4 June to 4 July 2025, and counter 350 had a whole-day warning outage on 23 Oct 2025; both periods are set missing. The Sep 2025 counter replacement reads comparably, so each direction is one continuous series.
